# Motif

> Immediate-mode UI framework for Rust with Metal GPU rendering.

Licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.

## Architecture

### Crates

- `motif` - Main crate, re-exports core, examples
- `motif_core` - Geometry, scene, Metal renderer, text system, elements
- `motif_debug` - Debug server (Unix socket at `/tmp/motif-debug-{pid}.sock`)
- `motif_debug_cli` - `motif-debug` CLI for runtime inspection
- `motif_test` - Test utilities

### Core Concepts

- **Coordinate Spaces**: LogicalPixels (DPI-independent) vs DevicePixels (physical)
- **Scene**: Typed primitive vectors (quads, text runs) in device pixels
- **DrawContext**: Painter's stack with closure-scoped transform/clip
- **Element System**: `Render` (stateful), `RenderOnce` (stateless), `Div`, `Text`, `Button`
- **ArcStr**: Cheap-clone string (Static or Arc-backed)

### Key Files

- `motif_core/src/geometry.rs` - Point, Size, Rect, Edges, Corners, ScaleFactor
- `motif_core/src/scene.rs` - Scene, Quad, TextRun
- `motif_core/src/context.rs` - DrawContext painter's stack
- `motif_core/src/metal/` - MetalRenderer, MetalSurface, shaders.metal
- `motif_core/src/elements/` - Div, Text, Button, element traits
- `motif_debug/src/server.rs` - Debug server, JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol

## Development

```bash
cargo run --example playground     # main example
cargo hot --example hot -F hot     # hot reload
motif-debug scene.stats            # inspect running app
motif-debug screenshot             # capture frame
```

## Debug CLI (`motif-debug`)

Connects to a running motif process via Unix socket (`/tmp/motif-debug-{pid}.sock`).

```bash
# Scene inspection
motif-debug scene.stats                          # quad count, text runs, viewport, scale
motif-debug scene.quads                          # all quads with bounds and color
motif-debug scene.text_runs                      # text runs: origin, font size, glyph count

# Input state
motif-debug input.state                          # cursor position, buttons, modifiers

# Screenshots
motif-debug screenshot [path]                    # capture frame to PNG (auto-path if omitted)

# Debug overlays
motif-debug draw.quad x y w h r g b a           # add overlay quad (logical px, colors 0.0–1.0)
motif-debug debug.list                           # list active overlays
motif-debug debug.remove <id>                    # remove overlay by id
motif-debug debug.clear                          # clear all overlays

# Input simulation (macOS, uses CGEvent)
motif-debug input.activate                       # bring app window to front
motif-debug input.move_to <x> <y>               # move cursor to window-local coords
motif-debug input.click <x> <y>                 # click at coords
motif-debug input.mouse_down <x> <y>            # press mouse button
motif-debug input.mouse_up <x> <y>              # release mouse button
motif-debug input.drag <x1> <y1> <x2> <y2>     # drag from one point to another

# Flags and REPL
motif-debug --json scene.stats                   # raw JSON output (for scripting)
motif-debug --socket /path/to/sock scene.stats   # explicit socket path
motif-debug                                      # interactive REPL mode (quit/exit to leave)
```

## Known Issues

Metal's `float3` has 16-byte alignment (not 12). Use three `float` fields instead of `float3 _padding` in shaders.
